item.title: Dangote refinery says begun fuel exports in Africa | Radarr Africa
item.description: Nigeria’s Dangote mega-refinery has begun exporting fuel to several African countries as global oil prices continue to climb sharply in the wake of escalating conflict in the Middle East. The three-week-old war has disrupted crude shipments through the strategic Strait of Hormuz, forcing nations to scramble for alternative supplies and brace for higher energy costs.
